admin.rerollLeaderHint: Randomly choose the starting leader and update the initial Lady of the Lake holder. Roles stay the same. The same leader may be selected again.
admin.rerollRolesHint: Shuffle the configured roles among all players, replace old identity hints, and ask everyone to view and confirm their new identity. Previously seen information cannot be forgotten; check with the table before proceeding.
admin.openingOnlyHint: Available only at the opening, before the first proposal or Merlin identification. Retracting or rewinding does not reopen these tools.
admin.title: Referee Tools
admin.enableHint: Enabling referee tools lets you unbind players, vote, or propose on their behalf. Every action is logged publicly in red for the whole table to see.
admin.unbindHint: Boot the player from their seat. The seat becomes open for anyone to re-claim and take over the identity with full history.
admin.proposeHint: Pick {size} member(s) for the current leader
admin.retractVotesHint: Before the result is published, clear everyone's cast votes so they can vote again.
admin.retractProposalHint: Cancel this proposal and return to team building for the current leader to propose again.
admin.previousPhaseHint: Restore the previous phase, leader, team and results. Votes or mission cards for that phase must be submitted again. Revealed identities and inspections cannot be forgotten.
admin.startAssassinationHint: End the current discussion or voting and let the Assassin identify Merlin. Hitting Merlin wins for the red team; missing wins for the blue team.
